shortDescription: Hungary's calendar-adjusted retail sales (HURETY=ECI) rose by an annual 4.9% in July following an 3.0% rise in June, the Central Statistics Office (KSH) said on Friday.Food sales rose by 2.2% year-on-year, while non-food sales rose by 6.5%. Fuel sales rose by 8.1% in annual terms, the KSH said.
